alignment_contract.depth_coverage: Require z_feature_count * teacher_stride >= native D; clamp the spec z coordinates against the actual source feature count.
alignment_contract.inplane_coverage: Require feature H/W to cover ceil(native_size/16) * (16/teacher_stride) complete teacher cells for each in-plane axis.
alignment_contract.pooling: Use exact unweighted avg_pool3d with kernel and stride (1,16/stride,16/stride) for strides 4 and 8; stride 16 is identity. Crop to ceil(H/16),ceil(W/16) after pooling and detach.
alignment_contract.producer_boundary: The helper no longer assumes MedNeXt's min-32 padding; producer-specific feature extraction remains responsible for its own padded geometry.

new_regressions: D=6 accepts one stride-8 z feature when native depth is covered and in-plane cells are complete
odd-edge pooling averages all four source cells without overlap weighting

synthetic_smoke.detail: Config validation stopped before training: synthetic tokenizer smoke requires at least 200 Q updates, while smoke_q3d.py defaults to 1. No T/Q/P/J execution evidence was produced.

evidence_boundary: Software-only focused tests; no patient, GPU, efficacy, clinical, gate-pass, or end-to-end synthetic smoke claim.
